items.q: The city where our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was born.
The year of our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ birth is known by this name.
The month of our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ birth, by the most famous view.
The father of our Beloved Master ﷺ, who died before He ﷺ was born.
The mother of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The wet-nurse of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ in the desert.
The grandfather who cared for our Beloved Prophet ﷺ after His ﷺ mother died.
The uncle who raised and protected our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The title the people of Makkah gave our Beloved Prophet ﷺ for His ﷺ honesty.
Our Beloved Master's ﷺ first wife, a noble merchant woman.
The age at which the first revelation came.
The first man (adult free man) to accept Islam.
The first child to accept Islam.
The first woman to accept Islam.
The tribe of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
Our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ clan within Quraysh.
The first muezzin, who was tortured for his faith in Makkah.
The night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem.
The ascent through the heavens.
The migration to Madinah.
The angel who brought the first revelation.
The first word of the Qur'an revealed.
The surah whose opening verses were the first revelation.
The month in which the Qur'an began to be revealed.
The uncle of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ condemned by name in the Qur'an.
The youngest daughter of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
Having lost His ﷺ father before birth, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ grew up as this (Qur'an 93:6).
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was born in this year, by the common estimate.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was this age when His ﷺ mother died.
The place where our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ mother died, on the way back from Madinah.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was this age when His ﷺ grandfather 'Abd al-Muttalib died.
Our Beloved Master ﷺ worked as a young man looking after these.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was this age when He ﷺ married our lady Khadijah ﵂.
The servant of our lady Khadijah ﵂ who travelled with our Beloved Prophet ﷺ on her trade to al-Sham.
The Christian scholar, cousin of our lady Khadijah ﵂, who said the revelation was the same as came to our master Musa ﵇ (paraphrased).
After a pause in revelation, our Beloved Master ﷺ said "Wrap me up" (meaning), and this surah came down.
For about this many years, the call to Islam was private.
The hill from which our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called Quraysh openly.
The house in Makkah where early Muslims met in secret.
The first martyr in Islam, the mother of 'Ammar ibn Yasir ﵁.
The country the first Muslims migrated to.
The just Christian king of Abyssinia who protected them.
The Companion who spoke for the Muslims before al-Najashi.
items.a: Our master Ja'far ibn Abi Talib ﵁

items.q: The surah our master Ja'far ﵁ recited to al-Najashi.
The boycott of Banu Hashim lasted about this many years.
The valley where Banu Hashim were besieged.
The "Year of Sorrow" was when these two died (meaning).
items.a: Our lady Khadijah ﵂ and Abu Talib

items.q: The wife of Abu Lahab, called "the carrier of firewood" in the Qur'an.
"And warn your nearest kin" (meaning), the command to our Beloved Prophet ﷺ to call His ﷺ family, is in this surah.
The freedman, once adopted by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, who was among the very first to accept Islam.
The daughter of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who went to Abyssinia with her husband, our master 'Uthman ﵁.
The tribe of al-Ta'if.
The Companion who went with our Beloved Prophet ﷺ to al-Ta'if.
The surah that describes the Lote Tree seen on the Mi'raj.
The tree "at the furthest boundary" seen on the Mi'raj (meaning).
The town our Beloved Prophet ﷺ visited to call its people, where He ﷺ was stoned.
The Christian boy from Nineveh who offered our Beloved Prophet ﷺ grapes at Ta'if.
The animal our Beloved Prophet ﷺ rode on the Isra'.
On the Mi'raj, the prayers were reduced from fifty to this many.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who advised our Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Mi'raj to ask for fewer prayers.
The Companion who believed the Isra' at once and got the title "al-Siddiq".
The first pledge at 'Aqabah was made by this many people of Yathrib.
The Companion sent to teach the people of Yathrib after the first pledge.
The second pledge of 'Aqabah was made by about this many men and two women.
The two tribes of Yathrib.
The house where Quraysh met to plot against our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The Companion who slept in our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ bed on the night of the Hijrah.
The cave where our Beloved Master ﷺ and our master Abu Bakr ﵁ hid for three nights.
The verse "Do not grieve; Allah is with us" (meaning) is in this surah.
The daughter of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ called "Dhat al-Nitaqayn".
The guide they hired for the Hijrah journey.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (named in Sirat Ibn Hisham)

items.q: The rider who chased our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and our master Abu Bakr ﵁ on the Hijrah, and whose horse sank into the sand.
The first mosque built in Islam.
The Hijrah took place in this year.
The surah sent down after a pause in revelation: "Your Lord has not forsaken you" (meaning).
The Quraysh elder who offered wealth and rule if our Beloved Prophet ﷺ would stop, and heard Surah Fussilat in reply.
Quraysh asked for a sign, and this was split in two (Qur'an 54:1).
Quraysh, coached by the rabbis of Yathrib, asked about the youths of the cave, Dhul-Qarnayn and this.
The surah that answered with the story of the People of the Cave.
On the way back from al-Ta'if, a group of these listened to our Beloved Prophet ﷺ recite at Nakhlah.
The surah 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ﵁ recited aloud by the Ka'bah, according to Ibn Ishaq ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The Companion who freed Bilal ﵁ by buying him.
The master who tortured Bilal ﵁ on the hot sand.
The word Bilal ﵁ repeated under torture.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ prayed that Islam be strengthened by one of two men: our master 'Umar ibn al-Khattab ﵁ or this man.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ accepted Islam after hearing this surah at his sister's house.
The uncle of our Beloved Master ﷺ who accepted Islam shortly before our master 'Umar ﵁ and was called "Lion of Allah".
The Quraysh leader who said the Qur'an was magic after admitting its beauty, and about whom Surah al-Muddaththir speaks.
The Quraysh envoy sent to bring the Muslims back from Abyssinia, who later became a Companion.
The emigration to Abyssinia happened in this year of prophethood.
The boycott document was eaten by this, except the name of Allah.
The Makkan chief who gave our Beloved Prophet ﷺ protection to re-enter Makkah after al-Ta'if.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was offered that the angel of the mountains crush the people of Ta'if; He ﷺ hoped for this instead.
items.a: That their descendants would worship Allah

items.q: Our Beloved Master ﷺ led the Blessed Prophets ﵈ in prayer on the Isra' at this mosque.
On the Mi'raj, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was offered milk and wine and chose this.
The first pledge of 'Aqabah is also called this, as it had no pledge to fight.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ arrived at Quba' on this day of the week, by the common view.
The son of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ who brought news to the Cave of Thawr each night.
The freedman of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ who grazed sheep to hide their tracks.
The reward Quraysh offered for capturing our Beloved Master ﷺ and our master Abu Bakr ﵁.
The Quraysh man who put a camel's entrails on our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ back as He ﷺ prostrated.
The daughter who lifted the camel's entrails off our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ back as He ﷺ prostrated.
The Ansari who hosted Mus'ab ibn 'Umayr ﵁ in Yathrib.
The Aws chief who accepted Islam through Mus'ab ﵁ and brought his clan, Banu 'Abd al-Ashhal, with him.
Quraysh chose one young man from each clan to kill our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, so that this clan could not take revenge.
Leaving His ﷺ house on the night of the Hijrah, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ threw dust at the men outside while reciting from this surah.
The Companion from Ghifar who declared his Islam aloud at the Ka'bah and was beaten for it.
The scholar who wrote al-Sirah, the earliest major biography, later edited by Ibn Hisham ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
Ibn Hisham ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in this year.
The Andalusian commentary on Ibn Hisham's Sirah by al-Suhayli ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The book of Qadi 'Iyad ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ rights and qualities.
The Blessed Seerah by al-Halabi ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, widely read in Ottoman lands.
The book of al-Qastallani ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the Blessed Seerah and our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ virtues.
The Christian monk of Busra who recognised signs of prophethood in our Beloved Prophet ﷺ when He ﷺ was a boy.
The pact of chivalry in Makkah to defend the wronged, which our Beloved Prophet ﷺ attended.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ settled a dispute over placing this stone when the Ka'bah was rebuilt.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ settled the Black Stone dispute by putting the stone on this, so every clan could lift it.
The age of our Beloved Master ﷺ when Quraysh rebuilt the Ka'bah.
The opening of the chest (shaqq al-sadr) first happened while our Beloved Prophet ﷺ was with this nurse.
The first Muslim to recite the Qur'an aloud publicly in Makkah, according to Ibn Ishaq ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The tribe from al-Madinah whose six men met our Beloved Prophet ﷺ at 'Aqabah the year before the first pledge.
The Ansari leader who, by Ibn Ishaq's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ report, was first to give his hand at the second pledge of 'Aqabah.
items.src: Sirat Ibn Hisham (Banu al-Najjar said As'ad ibn Zurarah)

items.q: The number of leaders (nuqaba') chosen at the second pledge.
The Jewish rabbi of Madinah who accepted Islam soon after the Hijrah.
The Companion with whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ first stayed in Madinah.
Our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ camel, which chose where He ﷺ would stay.
The caliph who made the Hijrah the start of the Islamic calendar.
Abu Talib's long poem in defence of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, named after its rhyme letter.
The Quraysh man who led the effort to end the boycott of Banu Hashim.
The chief of Daws who stuffed his ears with cotton, then heard the Qur'an and accepted Islam.
The uncle of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who came with Him ﷺ to the second pledge of 'Aqabah, by Ibn Ishaq's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ report.
Ibn Ishaq ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ died in about this year.
The woman whose dry goat gave milk when our Beloved Prophet ﷺ passed her tent.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ left Makkah on the Hijrah in this month.
